marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to west 20 knots this evening and to west
25 after midnight. Wind diminishing to light Monday afternoon. Periods of rain changing to periods of drizzle overnight
and ending near noon Monday. Fog patches dissipating near noon
Monday. <br/>

marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 2 early Monday morning then
subsiding to 1 or less Monday evening.<br/>
